title: MRMPROBS tutorial dataset for MS-DIAL5
author: Buyantogtokh, Bujinlkham
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Gather required data files
steps.instruction: Collect the raw *.lcd file from mouse muscle lipid extraction (acquired on a Shimadzu QTOF LCMS‑9030 using DIA‑MS‑OAD), the MS‑DIAL output files named 20231204_QC_* and AlignmentResult_2024_01_16_17_*, and any additional files referenced in the MRMPROBS tutorial video.

steps.title: Load MRMPROBS project in MS‑DIAL
steps.instruction: Open MS‑DIAL and load the MRMPROBS_tutorial.mdproject file, making sure the files 20231204_QC_* and AlignmentResult_2024_01_16_17_ are present in the same folder as the project file.

steps.title: Execute tutorial analysis
steps.instruction: Follow the tutorial instructions inside MS‑DIAL, proceeding through each analysis step to reproduce the published results.

steps.title: Document instrument parameters
steps.instruction: Record that the DIA precursor isolation window is defined in swath_dictionary.txt; the LC system is a Nexera X2 UPLC (Shimadzu, Kyoto, Japan) using an Imtakt UK‑C18 MF column (50 mm × 2 mm, 3 µm); MS detection is performed on a QTOF‑MS (LCMS‑9030, Shimadzu, MA, USA); the sample was prepared by MTBE lipid extraction from C57BL/6J mice.
